prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit image1 neutral dialogue bust into ONE TRISTE expression of the EXACT SAME CHARACTER Trabalhador 2. Clearly SAD: both inner eyebrow corners raised, downcast gaze, downturned closed mouth, chin slightly lower and shoulders subtly drooping. No tears or crying effects.
Acting character guidance (Portuguese): Preocupado com contas e paralisação; alegria aliviada, tristeza cansada, raiva ansiosa e dúvida cautelosa.
INVARIANTS: Adult male goblin, narrow face, long pointed ears, neatly side-parted dark hair with a flat combed silhouette, fine long nose, small lower tusks. Worn light work tunic with rolled sleeves, modest buttoned neckline and simple narrow waist belt. Clean-shaven, no glasses, no tools, no jewelry, no weapons. Lean slightly stooped shoulders, hands loosely together near belt. Distinct from cropped-hair assaltante2 and inventor Nodri.
Image1 is checked neutral and primary identity/style/composition reference. Preserve exact face structure, age, anatomy, ears, nose, hair silhouette, tusk number/size, skin markings, garment construction/colors/embroidery, every accessory, belt and hand anatomy. Keep arms and hands in same resting pose; emotion comes from face and slight head/shoulder acting. Same camera angle, facing direction, character scale, framing, upper-left lighting and sepia palette. No mirroring. Do not redesign clothing or add wrinkles of age. Coreto black ink contours, fine crosshatching and stipple, sepia/cream. Preserve complete silhouette with transparent margins; all ears, head and hands inside canvas. True alpha transparency, no scenery, symbols, text, speech bubbles, objects, weapons or effects.
inspecao_visual: Comparação lado a lado dos cinco PNGs no tamanho final: rosto, anatomia, mãos, roupas, acessórios, escala, orientação, luz e distinção das emoções. Transparência visual em fundo cinza, sem halos aparentes.
